post.description: Put a customer on a plan you invoice yourself (no card needed).
Start the Launch Agent. Returns the job straight away; progress arrives as live "agent" events.

get.description: The signed-in person, plus the workspace they're working in when it's a client's.

post.description: Start a Razorpay subscription; the frontend opens the returned short_url (or Razorpay Checkout with its id).
Pull spend/impressions/clicks and (if a lead form id is set) new leads from Meta.

get.description: An optional AI-written weekly brief over the same numbers (falls back to the rule-based summary).

post.description: Headline/primary text variants for ads, in the Brand Kit's voice. Gemini when configured, templates otherwise.
Turn a short idea into a detailed, brand-aware prompt the user can read and edit before generating.

get.description: The editing engines, plus which extra tools work: object selection, background swap and AI upscaling need fal.ai.
Whole-image style presets for the editor's style menu and /slash commands.

post.description:
Bring your own photo (product shot, room, person, anything) into the editor. Phone photos are turned upright
from their EXIF data. Saved as a normal image in History, so every editing tool works on it.
Every placement size from one image, with the headline and button typeset by us (always spelled right).
Keep the main subject exactly and paint a new background around it (fal.ai: cut-out + FLUX Fill).
Apply pinned comments to an image. Saves a new version linked to the original; the original is never changed.
Make another placement size by painting in the missing edges instead of cropping. The original stays untouched.
Bigger, sharper copy: AI upscaling with fal.ai, or a basic high-quality resize without a key (labelled as such).
Add matching audio (MMAudio) to an existing silent video.

get.description: Private files: only the owner can view their uploads and branded images.
Liveness: the process answers. Cheap, no database, safe for an uptime checker to hit every minute.
Which Gemini key AI features will use for this user: their own, the server's, or none (templates).

patch.description: Non-secret per-integration settings, e.g. google {sheet_id, auto_sync}, meta {ad_account_id}.

post.description: Have the AI voice agent phone this lead (needs Twilio).
Attach a campaign or landing page to a product (or detach it).

get.description: Everything the user can pick in a generator: built-ins plus their own providers.
Readiness: the process can serve real requests (the database answers). Load balancers route traffic on this.

post.description: Three clearly different designs for the same brief, rendered instantly (no AI cost) so the user can pick one.
A library image as an inline (compressed) source the visual editor can drop into a public page.
Pre-fill a brief from the business's existing website (or a social/Google page that renders HTML).
How complete the brief is and the few questions that would improve the page most (cheap, no AI).

Change part of the page in plain words ("make this darker", "add three FAQs"). With a section, the rewritten
section comes back for the editor to drop in (and autosave). Without one, the whole page is rewritten and saved.

get.description: Owner-only render for thumbnails: works for drafts and doesn't count as a visit.

post.description: One-step launch: name, address, SEO, pre-launch checks, then deploy.
Run the template agent for this business: personal versions, proven winners and industry gaps.
Called when something is created from a template, so the agent can learn which fields people change.
Test the inbox without a real number: pretend a customer messaged you.

delete.description: Deletes a client workspace and everything in it (sites, leads, campaigns...). Owners only; type its name.

get.description: The page's brochure PDF (shown to visitors after they leave their details).
